title: Migrated skill doc still instructs editing Claude Code MCP config (.claude/mcp.json)
evidence: 2. Add configuration to your MCP settings (.claude/mcp.json or IDE equivalent)
detail: The PR retires Claude Code and migrates skills to .pi/skills, but this migrated file still points users at Claude Code's MCP config path. Stale harness guidance survives the rename-only move; pi's MCP config lives elsewhere.
recommended_fix: Update the setup step to reference the pi MCP configuration location (or a harness-agnostic 'your agent harness MCP settings') in a follow-up content pass.
